title: API principles
text: main input argument called labels vector age, period, cohort labels. Arguments beginning interpret_ describe existing input labels parsed. describe newly generated output labels rendered. Age labels follow strong demographic convention: one-year labels use lower boundary, multi-year labels exclude upper boundary. Age functions therefore expose interpret_single interpret_multi arguments. Period cohort labels universal convention, period cohort functions consume labels (example period_standard() cohort_coarsen()) let specify inputs parsed. period cohort labels constructors take interpret_ arguments; create new labels instead. example, period_standard() uses interpret_multi interpret input: Label-consuming functions also take interpret_fail, controls happens label parsed ("error", "warn", "silent"). Arguments beginning format_ describe new output labels rendered. period cohort labels constructors expose format_single format_multi. Age labels functions hard-code usual demographic conventions. example, period_labels_ten() uses format_multi decide whether displayed upper limit included excluded: convention keeps input interpretation separate output formatting. (mapping functions use different argument named format, chooses tibble matrix return value.)
code: period_standard("2020-2025", interpret_multi = "exclude") #> [1] "2020-2026" period_labels_ten(   lower_first = 2000,   lower_last = 2020,   format_multi = "exclude" ) #> [1] "2000-2009" "2010-2019" "2020-2029"

title: API principles
text: Boundary arguments name boundary represent. breaks boundaries intervals. lower_first lower bound first generated interval. lower_last lower bound last generated interval. breakpoint intervals become open, e.g. 70 70+ 1990 <1990. function name specifies whether intervals open left right. boolean arguments open_left open_right control whether include open intervals start end generated label sequence. Age groups support open_right ; periods cohorts support directions. labels functions, arguments default explicit boolean values constructing new label grid. coarsen functions, defaults NULL, preserves open/closed topology labels: open ends kept present, omitted . Use open_left = TRUE open_right = TRUE add structural open level even value labels currently belongs group.

Use open_right = TRUE add open level even value labels currently belongs open group, age_set_open_right() : diagnose assert functions follow levels contract: factor validate levels, including unused ones. Use diagnose_values assert_values functions want check observed values (example grouped pipeline). assert functions return labels invisibly checks pass, can sit pipeline.
